House with a Sweet and Cozy Scent (BGM)

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleA_V11
say: I should bring a friend next time I come.
markers.label: NPC 7005001

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleA_V2
say: Which table should I sit at?
markers.label: NPC 7005001

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleA_V4
say: Soda and Cocoa are so cute!
Ade is like the maid to end all maids.
markers.label: NPC 7005001

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleA_V7
say: I wonder if they have a secret menu of some kind?
markers.label: NPC 7005001

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleB_V11
say: I should also buy some merchandise.
markers.label: NPC 7005002

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleB_V3
say:
I'm so excited I finally got to try
the cake that I pre-ordered!
I wonder how delicious the other desserts are?
markers.label: NPC 7005002

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleB_V6
say: All the maids are so friendly.
markers.label: NPC 7005002

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleB_V9
say: I'm gonna come back tomorrow for sure.
If I could, I would live here.
markers.label: NPC 7005002

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleC_V10
say: I'm gonna buy this... and that...
markers.label: NPC 7005003

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleC_V3
say: This place always looks nice, but you've decorated it especially wonderfully today!
I want to decorate my room like this too.
markers.label: NPC 7005003

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleC_V8
say: Soda and Cocoa's performance is so amazing!
markers.label: NPC 7005003

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleC_V9
say: What kind of merchandise do they have on sale?
markers.label: NPC 7005003

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleD_V10
say: Oh man, I'm gonna end up overspending...
markers.label: NPC 7005004

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleD_V2
say: There's so much stuff that I wanna buy!
markers.label: NPC 7005004

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleD_V5
say: I'm gonna snag Ade's photo album for sure.
markers.label: NPC 7005004

markers.name: Citizen_FemaleD_V6
say: Oooh, and Soda's special parfait as well.
I wonder how Cocoa's cookies taste?
markers.label: NPC 7005004

markers.name: Citizen_MaleB_V10
say: We should check out that performance.
markers.label: NPC 7005005

markers.name: Citizen_MaleB_V11
say: There's no other cafe like this in the entire Ark!
markers.label: NPC 7005005

markers.name: Citizen_MaleB_V4
say:
I think I'll order the omurice
with loads of ketchup on top.
markers.label: NPC 7005005

markers.name: Citizen_MaleB_V5
say: It's nice to see them working so hard for the customer...
markers.label: NPC 7005005

markers.name: Citizen_MaleC_V1
say:
I'm gonna decide once and for all
who's the perfect maid.
markers.label: NPC 7005007

markers.name: Citizen_MaleC_V3
say: Which maid should I focus on...
markers.label: NPC 7005007

markers.name: Citizen_MaleC_V6
say: I wonder how the other maids are doing?
markers.label: NPC 7005007

markers.name: Citizen_MaleC_V7
say: Soda is a bit of a klutz, but that's all part of her charm.
It's hard to tell what's going on in Cocoa's head sometimes.
Ade usually seems the most sincere out of all of them.
markers.label: NPC 7005007

markers.name: Citizen_MaleD_V1
say: There are so many delicious items!
markers.label: NPC 7005008

markers.name: Citizen_MaleD_V5
say:
I wanna try this...
Ooh, and that, too...
markers.label: NPC 7005008

markers.name: Citizen_MaleD_V6
say: The parfait looks divine as well.
markers.label: NPC 7005008

markers.name: Citizen_MaleD_V7
say: And the handmade chocolate looks out of this world.
markers.label: NPC 7005008

markers.name: Citizen_MaleD_V9
say: Oh boy, just looking at all this is making me drool!
markers.label: NPC 7005008

markers.name: Citizen_Male_Otage_V1
say: I don't see what's so special about this place.
It just seems like an ordinary cafe.
markers.label: NPC 7005006

markers.name: Citizen_Male_Otage_V2
say:
Soda & Cocoa?
Are they gonna be putting on some kind of show?
A maid performance? That seems interesting.
markers.label: NPC 7005006

markers.name: Cocoa_V1
say: Magic show. A massive dessert. Ketchup performance...
It's all too much information. My brain can't handle it.
markers.label: Character 311

markers.name: Cocoa_V2
say: How about Soda and Cocoa do a dance?
I'm pretty confident with my own dancing.
markers.label: Character 311

markers.name: Soda_V1
say: Do we have any surprises that'll keep the customers entertained?
markers.label: Character 312

markers.name: Soda_V2
say: We've made the decision to do a performance,
but we haven't ironed out all the details yet.
markers.label: Character 312

markers.name: Aid_V2
say: If you'd like to know your total, just let me know.
Is there anything else that you need?
markers.label: Character 310

markers.name: Aid_V5
say:
You can order any of the omurice and the various desserts
that you see here.
markers.label: Character 310

markers.name: Aid_V6
say:
Do keep in mind that the performance is set for
only a few designated times.
markers.label: Character 310

markers.name: Aid_V7
say: As always, thank you for visiting the Maid For You Cafe.
markers.label: Character 310

markers.name: Anis_V1
say: Wow, there are a lot of customers.
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Anis_V3
say: Will they be performing here too?
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Anis_V4
say: The place is so clean it's sparkling! They must have put a lot of effort into cleaning.
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Anis_V5
say: They've got a limited-edition photo album as well?
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Anis_V6
say: I could stay here forever and never run out of delicious things to eat.
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Anis_V7
say: I can come back here again, can't I?
markers.label: Character 12

markers.name: Neon_V3
say: I noticed some ketchup in my pudding...
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Neon_V4
say: If I shout firepower there, how loud would it sound?
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Neon_V5
say: Looks like there's all sorts of things we can buy here.
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Neon_V6
say: Cocoa is as adept as ever with the ketchup.
markers.label: Character 11

markers.name: Neon_V7
say: I want to live in a place like this someday!
markers.label: Character 11

notes.text: Soda and Cocoa are making plans for the upcoming performance...
The cafe guests' interest seems to have been piqued...
Soda and Cocoa are performing on stage!
The cafe guests cheer loudly for the performance!
